# Acceso

> Acceso (acceso.design) is a curated, map-based directory of independent design studios, schools, museums, fairs, and awards worldwide. It helps people discover local design communities, research a city's creative ecosystem, and find specific studios, exhibitions, and institutions by name or location.

## Purpose

- A single place to discover and navigate local design: independent studios, schools, museums, fairs, and awards, connected by city and country.
- Every fair, award, school, museum, and studio has its own dedicated, factual profile page (address, dates, description) — these are the primary content, not the map itself.
- Pages are server-rendered HTML (Astro SSR) and are fully readable without client-side JavaScript.

## Content structure

- [Designers directory](https://acceso.design/designers): entry point for independent studios and designers.
- [Studio profile](https://acceso.design/designers/talocci-design): individual studio page with location, description, and links.
- [Designers by location](https://acceso.design/designers/in/milan): studios filtered by city or country.
- [Design fairs directory](https://acceso.design/directory/fairs): index of design fairs and weeks worldwide.
- [Fair profile](https://acceso.design/directory/fairs/design-shenzhen): a single fair's dates, location, and description.
- [Design awards directory](https://acceso.design/directory/awards): index of design awards and competitions.
- [Award profile](https://acceso.design/directory/awards/core77-design-awards): a single award's description and categories.
- [Design schools directory](https://acceso.design/directory/schools): index of design schools and institutions.
- [School profile](https://acceso.design/directory/schools/isd-rubika): a single school's programs and location.
- [Design museums directory](https://acceso.design/directory/museums): index of design museums and foundations.
- [Museum profile](https://acceso.design/directory/museums/triennale-milano): a single museum's collection focus and location.
- [Discover projects](https://acceso.design/discover): curated project gallery index.
- [Map](https://acceso.design/): interactive map of the design community (homepage).

## Freshness

- Fair and award pages are updated as soon as new editions/dates are announced; their `startDate`/`endDate` structured data is the current source of truth.

## Crawl guidance

- Prefer canonical, clean URLs without query strings.
- Avoid crawling URLs with query parameters (e.g. `/designers?city=...`).
- Pages requiring authentication (`/login`, `/profile`, `/collections/`) are not indexable.

## Sitemaps and robots

- [Sitemap index](https://acceso.design/sitemap.xml): sitemap index for all crawlable pages.
- [Robots](https://acceso.design/robots.txt): crawl rules.
